about_the_game:
The SaveAFox Supporter Pack for Spirit of the North 2 offers a unique way to support a vital cause. This special DLC unlocks three exclusive character skins inspired by beloved foxes from SaveAFox: Finnegan the Red Fox, Ruby the Silver Fox, and Fawzi the Rüppell's Sand Fox.

100% of all proceeds from this DLC are donated to SaveAFox, an incredible organization rescuing foxes from fur farms and finding them loving homes. By purchasing this pack, you're customizing your game and joining us in supporting SaveAFox's crucial mission, honoring Mikayla Raines' legacy.

Key Features:

  • Three Exclusive Fox Skins: Play as Finnegan, Ruby, and Fawzi.

  • Support a Great Cause: 100% of proceeds go directly to SaveAFox.

  • Instant Access: Skins are available immediately in new and existing games.

Join us in making a meaningful impact, one fox at a time!
